invariants: Actual pinned Node 22.22.2 ICU 78.2/Unicode 17/CLDR 48 default-locale comparisons, 180 real request fingerprints and five actual canonical-engine cursor journeys match the native runtime (2034 observations).
Stable localeCompare ties preserve original filter and clause order, including canonical equivalents, ignorable characters, embedded NUL, astral and unpaired UTF-16 surrogates.

Pinned private ICU files and all seven licenses are verified before loading or Portable replacement. The exact owned library paths and actual ICU/Unicode/CLDR identities are required; external ICU data files are disabled.
The collator enables normalization, including non-FCD input sequences; close is idempotent and late comparison is refused.

The release gate binds the full fresh source observation digest and locale. Extracted isolated Python 3.8.10 must reproduce all observations with candidate module, exact private libraries and normalization identity.
identity: Declared current default locale matches actual pinned Node; request identities preserve stable ICU ties and distinct code units.
ownership: Process-owned lazy collator, private hash-pinned DLLs and bound in-memory common data; no Node or compiler is a Portable dependency.
ordering: Verify all metadata and files, load absolute owned libraries, validate runtime identities, enable normalization, compare UTF-16 and stably sort captured values/clauses.
errors: Missing, corrupt, foreign or malformed files, identities and observation receipts are deliberate refusals; reversed equal-collation values retain the actual typed invalid-cursor response.
cancellation: The synchronous pure comparison does not add asynchronous ownership; engine cancellation/drain remains defined by CON-SESSION-QUERY-ENGINE.
adaptation: Unchanged ICU release-78.2 source compiled with pinned LLVM-MinGW MSVCRT and static C++ runtime, Windows 7 target and deterministic PE timestamps; official matching data DLL and licenses are bundled.
open_questions: Full Unicode regex, case folding and event extraction, other domain locale orders and every locale are not certified by this current-locale matrix.
Original startup cancellation, source fixed-wait cache races and existing Proactor warning remain separate findings.
Real Win7 execution is deferred; PE dependencies and target settings do not replace real-machine certification.
